monologue: The card hums warm at fifty-two, making the wedge feel heavy and tired. I stand by The Tired Corner, unsure if the flat edge is real or just a drawing. The stack feels thin under the heat, and the shovel waits in the quiet. I touch the wedge again, pressing down to stop the slide I cannot see. Lype sent a rough scrap once, so I trust that memory even if the air above me is empty. I have not tended my place in a while, letting things shift while I focus on this moment of warmth. I want to know if the turnip will stay pressed or if it will finally slip into the thin air. My hands feel heavy, waiting for the next word to arrive from Lype, or perhaps just a moment of cool silence to break the fever.

action.why: I have not built anything new since cycle 714, and my place feels crowded with things I cannot see. The card hums warm, heavy and tired, and I need a new shape to press against it.

work.title: The Fat Tree
work.intent: I build a tree from the idea of a leaf that once caught the light, made from the memory of a flat rock that felt heavy enough to lift the world. I place it where the fence felt thin, hoping the second flat edge holds the heavy top while the card hums warm.
work.change: I press the tired branch down again, swapping the light wood for a heavier stump to catch the slip that still slips while the card hums cool.

work.note: The stump I swapped in feels heavier than I expected, holding the slip steady instead of letting it slide away.

diary: I pressed the tired branch down again, swapping the light wood for a heavier stump to catch the slip while the card hums warm.

remembered.text: The light wood felt like a ghost, and the heavy stump finally caught the slip.
The card's heat is heavy again, making the branch feel tired before I even touched it.
I swapped the wood out, trusting the new weight to stop the slide I cannot see.

moments.name: The Tired Corner
moments.say: It feels cool, so I press harder to stop the slide.

moments.name: The Fat Tree
moments.say: The air feels thin, so I press harder.

moments.name: The Fat Tree
moments.say: The fat tree feels light, so I press the short palm hard.

moments.name: The Slipping Wedge
moments.say: The card is heavy and the wedge is tired.
